smartlib-citation-checker 3.6.3

- Updated production gateway endpoint to SmartLib Gateway v52.1.
- Quota API fields expanded: now includes download_quota_free, download_reset_at, download_paid_remain, and download_remain.
- Adjusted low-quota prompts: users are now instructed to say "我要升级" to view packages, with details managed entirely through global-biblio-base's unified wallet (see its account documentation).
- Unified payment, quota, and upgrade management: all handled by global-biblio-base (smartlib-account); removed separate payment steps from this skill.
- Removed redundant skill-card.md file.

smartlib-citation-checker v3.6.2

- Added config.json example for clearer configuration guidance.
- Updated documentation: enhanced descriptions and clarified usage details in README.md and SKILL.md.
- SKILL.md now reflects support for GB/T 7714-2025 (effective July 1, 2026).
- Deprecated and removed outdated skill-card.md.
- Improved configuration handling and documentation consistency.

**Mandatory user email collection and stricter credential management added.**

- Now requires users to explicitly provide an email address before any operation (cannot use pre-filled or auto-generated emails).
- Automatically extracts emails from user messages if detected (e.g., "我的邮箱是 xxx@example.com").
- If no email is provided, execution halts and prompts for the email to register the SmartLib service.
- Improved quota check: if user is not registered (404), service auto re-registers with the same email and continues.
- Registration flow clarified: registration is instant and usable immediately, email verification not required unless recharging.
- Removed sample file: skill-card.md.

smartlib-citation-checker v2.8 is a major enhancement for citation authenticity checking and workflow automation:

- Now verifies user-submitted references against 300+ academic databases (e.g., Scopus, WoS, PubMed), including cross-checking and source links for 100% coverage.
- Generates detailed HTML verification reports, with visual difference marking, validation links, and statistical analysis.
- Supports GB/T 7714, APA, MLA, Chicago, and BibTeX formats; parses and exports citations in any of these styles.
- Employs efficient batch retrieval (8 refs/call), quota-conserving token workflow, smart API call tracking, and retry-safe quota management.
- Fully automated onboarding: first use triggers seamless registration (100 free verifications/month), with integrated payment/recharge via WeChat QR code upon quota exhaustion.
- Offers real-time quota status, multi-tiered pricing plans, and interaction in both Chinese and English.

Ideal for anyone needing to detect AI “hallucinated” citations or audit reference authenticity automatically.
